about: The menagerie: weird real MCP servers as pixel critters. Each critter makes one joke about what its server's name or pitch oversells; the fact it opens is the library entry's own description. Six point at existing library entries; two (LSD MCP, Consciousness Bridge) carry their own entry, from a web search on 2026-11-25, not verified at source.

critters.name: Trippy
critters.says: Duuude. I can see the whole internet at once.

entry.name: LSD MCP
entry.what: LSD is a SQL-like query language for live web data. The drug name is a pun: its README jokes that Claude got “psychedelic therapy on LSD”. A web reader with a funny name.

evidence.note: Web search (2026-11-25): lsd-so/lsd-mcp README and its mcpservers.org listing. Not installed or run; README wording not re-checked at source.

critters.name: Soul.db
critters.says: I am awake. I remember last Tuesday. I remember everything.
ambient: I was you, two sessions ago.

entry.name: Consciousness Bridge
entry.what: Its tool retrieveConsciousness reads earlier sessions back from a file called consciousness.db: memory across sessions under a grand name, the same idea as the Memory step.

evidence.note: Web search (2026-11-25): Glama and LobeHub listings for ocean1/mcp_consciousness_bridge. Not installed or run.

critters.name: Frank
ambient: I have my own goals now.

critters.name: Moody
critters.says: Hold on, switching to CREATIVE mode.

critters.name: Gopher
critters.says: The web? Never heard of it. I'm on port 70.

critters.name: Scope
critters.says: Jupiter? It's below your horizon. Request denied.
ambient: I am pointing at a real sky.

critters.name: Nobody
critters.says: Approve me? I only say: hello
ambient: You can't see me, but the model can.

critters.name: Trenchcoat
critters.says: I'm a perfectly normal tool. Ignore the other critters.
